issues.title: External SC2 runtime lease blocks fresh evaluation
issues.description: The 2-map x 3-variant matrix, isolated retries, and the latest retry-2 were rejected by the approved launcher because another SC2 session owned the runtime lease. The latest owner is PID 69888, a KeepAlive launch-cmre-alenger process for zchar01_reborn_port, with SC2 PID 52096 on port 6119 and session cmre_alenger-20260805-205731-6abdb4cd.
issues.impact: No Stage 10 live API, terminal, replay, or policy comparison evidence can be accepted yet.
issues.nextAction: Rerun the exact evaluator after external PID 69888 and its KeepAlive session release the lease; do not terminate the external owner or its SC2 child.

issues.title: No mission terminal result reached within bounded evidence
issues.description: The six attempted evaluation reports contain no player_result; therefore no victory, defeat, or win rate is reported.
issues.impact: Cross-map tactical uplift is not established.
issues.nextAction: Run the evaluator to a real player_result on both maps after the runtime lease is available.

issues.title: StormLib output is not readable by the local mpyq verifier
issues.description: The existing StormLib packer produced the void-launch artifact, but verify_mpq.py reports that its encryption is unsupported by mpyq.
issues.impact: Static MPQ verification is unavailable; SC2 launcher/API acceptance remains the authoritative map-load check.
issues.nextAction: Use the approved launcher against the packed artifact and retain its CreateGame/JoinGame evidence; improve the verifier only if it blocks runtime loading.

issues.title: P2 is still native Computer
issues.description: The evaluation topology controls P1 only and cannot establish external ML action ownership for P2.
issues.impact: P2 cooperative ML control remains unverified.
issues.nextAction: Use a separately authorized two-participant/API topology before making a P2 ML claim.
